The third alternative is to issue the standard for model years beyond 1979. However, the agency has tentatively decided to limit the AFES to MY 1979 only for several reasons. The Agency wishes to minimize the number of model years in which nonpassenger automobiles of 6,000 pounds and less GVWR are the only nonpassenger automobiles regulated. The agency is concerned about the possibility that the nonregulation of the nonpassenger automobiles above 6,000 pounds GVWR will cause some consumers to shift from buying lighter nonpassenger automobiles to buying heavier nonpassenger automobiles that are unregulated and less fuel economical. Nonpassenger automobiles above 6,000 pounds GVWR are very similar to nonpassenger automobiles of 6,000 pounds and less GVWR in configuration, price and utility, although the heavier vehicles tend to be slightly more expensive.
